tools.name: sap_pm_get_equipment
tools.description: Retrieve SAP PM equipment master data (description, functional location, object type, manufacturer, serial number, warranty dates) by equipment ID or functional location.

tools.name: sap_pm_list_notifications
tools.description: List SAP PM maintenance notifications for an equipment ID or functional location within a date range, including breakdown flag, malfunction start/end, and damage code.

tools.name: sap_pm_list_orders
tools.description: List SAP PM maintenance orders (order type, priority, planned/actual dates, operations, confirmations) for an equipment ID or functional location within a date range.

tools.name: sap_pm_get_breakdown_history
tools.description: Retrieve MTBF, MTTR, downtime hours, and cost history for an equipment ID from the PM Info System, to determine whether an incident represents a repeat failure.

tools.name: sap_pm_create_notification
tools.description: Create a SAP PM maintenance notification for a breakdown or observed issue. Requires human approval before submission; stages the notification and returns a confirmation payload rather than committing irreversibly.

tools.name: sap_pm_append_completion_note
tools.description: Append an approved root cause and corrective action summary as a completion note to an existing maintenance notification/work order. Requires explicit human (maintenance engineer) approval prior to invocation; never closes the notification or changes equipment master data.

request_id.description: Idempotency key to prevent duplicate write-back on retry
